english.note: Use this for bringing something into existence, especially an abstract result or heat and energy; it is more about producing a result than causing an event.

exampleSentences.english: This chemical reaction will generate heat.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個化學反應會產生熱力。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 faa3 hok6 faan2 jing3 wui5 caan2 sang1 jit6 lik6

english.note: Use this for producing an abstract result or for something coming into existence.

exampleSentences.english: This decision may engender a series of problems.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個決定可能產生一連串問題。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 nang4 caan2 sang1 jat1 lin4 cyun3 man6 tai4

english.note: Use this when something arises as a result, especially when money lent produces interest.

exampleSentences.english: The money I put in the bank will accrue interest every month.
exampleSentences.traditional: 放喺銀行嗰筆錢每個月都會產生利息。
exampleSentences.jyutping: fong3 hai2 ngan4 hong4 go2 bat1 cin4 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui5 caan2 sang1 lei6 sik1

english.note: Use this when something generates or brings about an effect, substance, or result rather than manufacturing an object.

exampleSentences.english: This chemical reaction will produce heat.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個化學反應會產生熱力。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 faa3 hok6 faan2 jing3 wui5 caan2 sang1 jit6 lik6
